notes.title: Update: v1.3.0.0
notes.content: -Updated camera controls for mouse and keyboard users. Camera now rotates around a pivot. You can adjust the distance to the pivot by zooming in and out.

notes.title: Update: v1.2.3.0
notes.content:
-Added support for settings when switching monitors
-Automatically hide or show mouse cursor depending on if a gamepad key was pressed

notes.title: Update: v1.2.2.0
notes.content:
-Updated tutorial for the controls for more clarity.
-Edited scene overall brightness and saturation to make it easier on the eyes.

notes.title: Update: v1.2.1.0
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with double input occurring on Steam Deck. 

I will probably not get it SD verified, due to a major overhaul of icons, naming and text sizes needed to be changed in order to pass the review. But it should be playable. Changes are reflected to the demo if you would like to test it.

Note when using a controller:
The control explanation in the help menu was not done well so I plan to update it for clarity.
You need to rotate the camera around the piece you have selected and view from the front, back, left, right, top, and bottom, to see the possible directions you can move to.
It sounds complicated but should feel natural once you get the hang of it.


-Fixed UI related bugs.

notes.title: Update: v1.2.0
notes.content:
Updated controls based on feedback received. Due to the removal and addition to inputs, keymapping is reset to default to avoid overlapping keys.

Patch Notes:
-Added support for mouse only control. Mouse wheel to zoom. Hold middle mouse to pan. Hold right click to tilt. (You can still use keyboard hotkeys, and "Shift" effects zoom and pan speed which is optional)

-Optimized keyboard and controller movement speed. movement is now faster by default.

-Increased the boost (Shift key) strength.

-Added an option to change movement speed in settings. This effects keyboard and gamepad movement.

-Menus are now open/closed with the back key for consistency.

-And other small improvements.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1.7.0
notes.content:
-Repeatedly pressing the difficulty up button caused the game to crash.
-Text animation looked strange when creating a quick save and returning to the title menu.
-New notify icon would appear on locked stages that are not available in the demo.


-Text now automatically scales for certain menus when changing the resolution to avoid text appearing too small.
-Improved translation for certain languages.
-Added language support for Bulgarian, Danish, Norwegian, Romanian, Finnish, Vietnamese, Ukrainian and Swedish.

notes.title: Update: Steam Achievements Added
notes.content:
Steam achievements have been implemented.

Achievements cannot be obtained in the demo.
If you are resuming from the demo save data and the conditions are met, achievements will automatically be obtained when booting up the retail version.

Achievements are permanent and will not be lost when starting a new game.

Made the following changes to the store page.

notes.title: Update : Cloud Save Feature Added
notes.content:
Cloud save feature should now be working.
Save data will also be shared from the demo to the release version.
